Leah: Quick FYI  noticed odd traffic shaping on the KPI board this morninglaunch-post MQLs fell ~28% during the webinar hour but overall traffic spiked. Board: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/launch-posts

Ben: Oof. Could be attribution mapping. I see a surge in `channel=unknown` for that hour.

Samantha: Pulled a sample of registrations. ~180 rows have utm_campaign empty but referrer contains webinar-provider.com. SQL used:
```
SELECT referrer, utm_campaign, count(*) FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-20T09:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-03-20T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY referrer, utm_campaign;
```
Big chunk with utm_campaign=NULL and referrer like `https://webinar-provider.com/r?e=...`

Ravi (mktg-ops): Heads up we rolled a tiny redirect tweak last week to handle new query params. I'll check the nginx access logs to see if querystrings were dropped on 302s.

kpi-bot: Alert: cohort="spring-launch" attribution-anomaly +29% relative to baseline. See https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/4820

Leah: Proposed immediate steps: 1) add referrer->campaign fallback in ETL, 2) quick reprocess for the last 48h, 3) call out the anomaly in today's KPI notes with both raw + reprocessed numbers. Agree?

Ben: Agree. Also suggest a micro-analysis comparing landing conversion for utm_present vs referrer_only to check creative impact.

Samantha: I'll draft the SQL for that micro-run and attach results. Short query:
```
SELECT
  CASE WHEN utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN 'utm' ELSE 'referrer_only' END AS bucket,
  count(*) as leads, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY bucket;
```
I'll post numbers in 30m.

Ravi (mktg-ops): If we reprocess, please pause SFDC imports for a short window. I'll coordinate with sales ops and post a notice.

Leah: Good call. For the weekly KPI review I'll add a slide called "Attribution note: webinar redirect" with the before/after and the micro-analysis.

kpi-bot: Deploy queued: web/4820 in ~6 minutes.
